title: Agentic Automation (n8n)
description: Host your own N8N workflow automation server with persistent storage.
fulldescription: This prototype launches a private instance of N8N, a powerful open-source workflow automation tool. It runs on **Amazon ECS (Fargate)**, which manages the server infrastructure for you. Crucially, it uses **Amazon EFS** (Elastic File System) to store your workflows and credentials, ensuring your data persists even if the container restarts or updates. A **Network Load Balancer** provides a stable web address to access your N8N editor, and **Amazon S3** is configured to handle automated backups. It is a robust, production-ready environment for connecting your apps and automating tasks without writing code.
